title: StandardBench-Monitor: A Standardized Benchmark Suite for Comparing AI Monitoring Approaches

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: a common benchmark enables progress accumulation in monitoring. Without a shared yardstick, monitoring methods cannot be rigorously compared. Infrastructure contribution with multiplicative impact on the field.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing multiple monitoring methods (LLM-based monitor, keyword filter, activation probe), running them against SHADE-Arena trajectories, building a scoring harness, and writing a blog post. This is a substantial software engineering project requiring familiarity with multiple monitoring paradigms.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three different monitoring methods, a scoring harness, evaluation on multiple task pairs, and a blog post. Each component is a mini-project. Even scoping to 5 task pairs, implementing 3 monitors plus a harness exceeds 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
